notes:
{右|みぎ} indicates the right direction, opposite of ⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {右|みぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がる→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧: to turn right
- {右|みぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look right
- {右|みぎ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧: from right to left (also: in one ear and out the other)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{右手|みぎて}→右手：10438_migite⟧: right hand
- ⟦{右足|みぎあし}→右足：28272_migiashi⟧: right foot/leg
- ⟦{右側|みぎがわ}→右側：24189_migigawa⟧: right side
- ⟦{右折|うせつ}→右折：09217_usetsu⟧: right turn (traffic term)
- ⟦{右利き|みぎきき}→右利き：17053_migikiki⟧: right-handed

POLITICAL USAGE:
{右|みぎ}/⟦{右翼|うよく}→右翼：12071_uyoku⟧ can mean "right-wing" in political contexts.

OPPOSITE:
⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧: left
